features.featureTitle: Wrap the root application component tree with MemberAuthProvider from 'frontend/src/hooks/useMemberAuth.tsx' so that member authentication context is available to all pages and components. Since 'frontend/src/main.tsx' is immutable, apply the MemberAuthProvider wrapper inside 'frontend/src/App.tsx' — wrap the RouterProvider (or the top-level JSX returned by App) with <MemberAuthProvider>.
